title: Construct nearby exact convex witnesses in fixed lattice fibres
statement: For S=(b+Lambda) intersect {integer x>=ell,x>=0}, fixed lattice Lambda, let H=sum_{g in signed Graver basis}||g||infinity. Conformal decomposition y-x=sum n_g g gives h=sum floor(n_g/2)g, balanced u=x+h,v=y-h in S, u+v=x+y and ||u-v||infinity<=H. Repeated balancing of a rational mean multiset preserves its mean and strictly decreases integer squared energy until diameter<=H. Caratheodory leaves at mostd+1 witnesses within H of the mean; limits use a fixed finite nearby integer box. For rational m in the closed convex hull, enumerate at most(2H+2)^d nearby integers, test fixed-lattice membership via normal forms and solve fixed-size rational feasibility, giving exact local mean weights in poly_Lambda(L) bit work. Huge multiset balancing is a proof device, not the extraction algorithm. This is for these lattice fibres, not all actual reaction classes.
